desc: Takes up very little space on your bench, but contains a durable and comprehensive 26 bits chosen to meet most of your gunsmithing needs. Included with the standard, Philips, hex and torx bits, is a 2" long #2 Philips bit which is ideal for recoil pad installation, and a hex-to-square conversion bit which allows you to use 1/4" square drive sockets and other attachments.
